name: valve_raven_mine_tunnel
note: Ravenholm's low mine tunnel (d1_town_04, x 1024 to 2304 at y 1152): 1280 of level rock tunnel, a closed tube of Valve's own displacements (rockwall015a walls and roof, blendrockgravel001a floor, power 2) on a 256 grid, two timber sets (16 by 16 posts 240 apart, cap, knee braces) at 0 and 256, a clamp lamp on the first, the rail bed's buffer. Anchor: the tunnel's axis at its west end, on the floor brush (z -5888). Left behind: the flood water (it runs past the box), the rail bed (the same), the lift lever (props only, dropped when placed).
